## Foods & dishes
- [[ArabCulture]]: 290 items, 59 food, only **1 Jordan-specific** (most are shared Levantine) + 7 food-adjacent.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 29 dishes, 1 Jordan-specific.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 4 dishes (43 rows). [[World Wide Dishes]]: 3 dishes, none Jordan-only.
- [[ArSyra Food and Culture]]: Jordan claimed; counts unknown.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Jordanian FCT in the vault; [[Bahrain Food Composition Tables]] contains 7 dish rows borrowed from it (labelled Bahraini).
- Candidates: [[EMFID (Eastern Mediterranean Food Information Data Bank)|EMFID]] (candidate, priority 1), [[Arabic Food 101]] (candidate; small Levantine dish image set from Jordan), [[Lebanon traditional dishes composition]] as a Levantine proxy.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 386 records (22 edible / **364 medicinal**). [[CMAUP]]: 118 plants (113 scraped). [[NPASS]]: 36 species–compound pairs.
- For compound → effect chains use the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions); [[FooDB]] has **no nigella/black seed, sumac, camel milk, za'atar, ghee or labneh**.

## Gaps
- No Jordan-specific dishes beyond a handful; no recipes with amounts; no composition data.
